role: Hard, style-free futures account owner applied after investment, risk and execution decisions. It keeps a marked-to-market cash ledger, restricts initial margin, calculates available funds, records margin calls and performs deterministic forced liquidation.
invariants: cash after equals cash before plus variation margin plus idle-cash interest minus financing cost minus forced-liquidation cost when external flows are zero
posted initial margin is restricted collateral and never deducted a second time from equity
available funds equals max(cash balance minus restricted initial margin, zero)
excess liquidity equals cash balance minus maintenance margin
pretrade account authorization can preserve or shrink an approved strategy target but never expand it
reduce-only and insolvent accounts cannot increase absolute exposure or run discretionary round trips
maintenance breach records a margin call and forces positions toward the configured recovery utilization in the same coarse half-month settlement
forced-liquidation slippage and fees reduce cash and are never hidden inside market prices
insolvency is sticky and prevents reopening risk
the account never writes back to market prices, volume, open interest, forecasts, strategy preferences or risk profiles
